visual_action: A static, high-angle shot of the U.S. House of Representatives chamber serves as the background. A cut-out of actor Christopher Walken is superimposed over the image. He briefly disappears and is replaced by a shot of his back as he stands in the aisle, then the front-facing shot returns.

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads: 'POV: you ask a Republican...'

cast.name: Seniors on Medicare
cast.evidence: The on-screen text specifies the policy is 'for seniors on Medicare'.

on_screen_text.text: POV: you ask a Republican to cap the cost of insulin at $35 for seniors on Medicare

spoken_summary: A dialogue between two men. The first man (with Christopher Walken's voice) says "No." The second man asks why, and the first man repeats "I said no," and when pressed for a reason, simply states, "I don't want to."
audio_music: Dialogue only, with no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: A static image with a simple, superimposed cut-out figure that is briefly animated through a few cuts.
manipulation_or_satire: A cut-out of actor Christopher Walken is superimposed onto a static image of the U.S. House of Representatives chamber to represent a Republican's reaction.
central_claim: Republicans are callously and arbitrarily refusing to cap the cost of insulin for seniors on Medicare.
intended_effect: To portray Republicans as unreasonable and uncaring, and to encourage viewers to oppose them on this issue.
